deals.headline: Watford offers about 10% of the club to fans via Republic at a £175m valuation
deals.investor: Fans and retail investors via Republic / Seedrs
deals.summary: Watford partnered with Republic to sell roughly 10% of its equity to retail investors (Seedrs for European fans), targeting £17.5m at a £175m valuation; shares carry no voting rights. The final amount raised is not confirmed on a citable page.

deals.headline: New Macquarie Bank secured facility (outstanding)
deals.summary: Charge 0010 4194 0059 created 6 June 2025 in favour of Macquarie Bank Limited, London Branch, outstanding. Amount not stated on the register page. The Supporters Board reading of the 2024-25 accounts puts third-party loans at £5.7m and loans from group undertakings at £53.5m at 30 June 2025.

name: Watford Football Club
notes: Club accounts for the year to 30 June 2025 (Companies House 00104194, filed 25 Mar 2026) are a scanned PDF with no text layer, so revenue, wages and pre-tax loss are cited from BBC Sport's report of those accounts (turnover given rounded as £26m) and the underlying operating loss from the Watford Supporters Board's review. The Supporters Board also reports total borrowing of £59.2m (group loans £53.5m, third parties £5.7m) and cash of £1.3m at 30 June 2025; no net-debt figure is stated, so net_debt is left null. Companies House PSC registers (00104194 and Hornets Investment Limited 08112624) give control bands (75% or more held by Hornets Investment Limited, itself 75% or more held by Gino Pozzo), not exact stakes. watfordfc.com is a JavaScript app whose text cannot be fetched, so stadium capacity, kit supplier and shirt sponsor were not sourced. A 2025 SportsPro report of talks to sell a ~10% Watford stake within a Udinese/SPAC deal was not confirmed and is not recorded. No Forbes/Sportico valuation; no dated follower counts found.

owners.evidence: Watford have been owned by the Pozzo family since 2012
owners.name: Gino Pozzo (Pozzo family)

ownership_summary: The Watford Association Football Club Limited is controlled (75% or more of shares and votes) by Hornets Investment Limited, which is in turn controlled (75% or more) by Gino Pozzo; the Pozzo family has owned the club since 2012. In June 2024 the club offered roughly 10% of its equity to fans and retail investors via Republic/Seedrs at a £175m valuation; the amount finally raised is not confirmed on a citable page.
revenue_evidence: Watford's annual turnover fell by £32m to £26m, but there was also a reduction in wage costs from £33m to £28.1m.
revenue_source_name: BBC Sport on Watford's financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2025
